question: Aarohi has to reach Lucknow which is 907 km away in 14 hours. His starting speed for 5 hours was 32 km/hr. For the next 81 km his speed was 27 km/hr. By what speed he must travel now so as to reach Lucknow in the decided time of 14 hours?
solution:
**Given:**

Total distance to Lucknow = 907 km

Total allowed time = 14 hours

First 5 hours speed = 32 km/h

Next 81 km speed = 27 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Remaining time = Total time − Time already taken

Required speed = Remaining distance ÷ Remaining time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance covered in first 5 hours = 5 × 32 = 160 km

⇒ Time taken for next 81 km = 81 ÷ 27 = 3 hours

⇒ Total distance covered so far = 160 + 81 = 241 km

⇒ Remaining distance = 907 − 241 = 666 km

⇒ Time already taken = 5 + 3 = 8 hours

⇒ Remaining time = 14 − 8 = 6 hours

⇒ Required speed = 666 ÷ 6 = 111 km/h

**∴ Aarohi must travel at 111 km/h to reach on time.**
